material_defects.problem: Primary analysis is defined on competent confirmation pairs only. Although competence is measured before interventions, conditioning the confirmatory sample on model behavior can be perceived as outcome-dependent sample selection and weakens the clean 20-pair randomization claim.
material_defects.required_repair: Use all 20 frozen confirmation pairs in the primary causal tests. Keep >=16/20 overall competence and >=8/13 delayed competence only as a cohort-level expressivity gate. Never replace/exclude an individual confirmation pair from the primary based on competence. Report competent-only analysis as secondary diagnostic if desired.

material_defects.problem: The frozen action suffix is "\nACTION: {command}" and meanLP scores all suffix tokens. A plan-state intervention could change probability of the shared ACTION label/newline rather than discriminate the commands, contaminating the action margin.
material_defects.required_repair: Put literal "\nACTION:" in the scoring prompt and score only suffix " {EXACT_COMMAND}". Patch the earlier <STATE_END> token using its explicit token index (capture.sequence_length-1), not the final scoring-prompt token. Freeze a tokenizer boundary guard for prompt+command.

material_defects.problem: normalize(h_A-h_B) is undefined when the source contrast norm is numerically zero/tiny, leaving post-hoc handling freedom.
material_defects.required_repair: Freeze epsilon=1e-8 FP32 L2. If norm<=epsilon, use the all-zero direction and define that control/intervention CPSE as the corresponding zero-patch effect; do not exclude/replace the pair. This is conservative against support.

material_defects.problem: "SHA256-seeded Gaussian" does not freeze a PRNG implementation/version, so the actual control vector can vary.
material_defects.required_repair: Replace with package-independent SHA256 Rademacher: for dimension j, sign=+1 iff first byte of SHA256(base|j) is even else -1, vector=sign/sqrt(d). Freeze exact base string and orientation.

material_defects.problem: Random-sign permutation is named but the design-based symmetry source is not explicit.
material_defects.required_repair: State that per-pair OPTION A/B orientation is assigned by a frozen cryptographic-hash Rademacher bit before model access and the one-sided sign-randomization tests are interpreted as design-based randomization over that orientation. Freeze Holm ordering/ties lexicographically by test name.
